prompts.scenePrompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production background illustration for the hero training and weapon upgrade page of a clean comic medieval fantasy mobile game. Use the attached shop image ONLY as the approved style and world reference. Confident dark espresso contours, clean broad color shapes, two or three crisp painted values, controlled angular highlights, attractive hand-designed game art; no photographic grain, plastic rendering, excessive engraving, soft AI airbrushing or glow. PORTRAIT 3:4 composition. A sunlit medieval royal training workshop: warm timber beams and small weapon shelves at the far left, sandstone arches, one royal navy-and-gold banner at far left, a cool bright sky and distant blue-roofed castle visible through an arch at upper right, simple sandstone floor visible in the bottom half. Strong warm/cool separation and clear foreground/middle/distant depth, like the shop image. Broad unobstructed hero display area at left-center, x=32% of the frame. A VERY LOW round pale sandstone training dais whose top-center is exactly x=32%, y=85%; the platform should occupy around 32% image width and have a believable elliptical top and a low 5% image-height base, with restrained contact shadow. Keep this dais fully visible. At right-center, quiet slightly darker sandstone wall and floor, with only two small tidy shelves of books and a closed chest far right. Upper 32% deliberately calm, since wallet and five hero cards are overlaid. A few carefully chosen props at extreme edges, no crowded repeated objects. Empty scene with no characters, no staff, no hanging UI panels, no text, no labels, no symbols pretending to be letters, no interface buttons. Ground and platform share one coherent perspective and lighting. Professional clean friendly fantasy game environment.
